palm.tipsTitle: How to get a clear palm reading
palm.tip1: Open your hand naturally with the palm facing directly toward the camera.
palm.tip2: Use bright, balanced daylight or indoor light; avoid harsh shadows across the palm.
palm.tip3: Keep the wrist crease and fingertips clearly within the frame.
palm.tip4: Ensure the camera focuses sharply on the major creases without beautify filters.
palm.cameraModalInstruction: Position your hand inside the guide with fingertips and wrist visible.
